In your count, include each link you would click on to get to the page. Use the pages as they appeared at the end of the day on July 3, 2023.

mistake_reason: The Assistant performed an incorrect verification (FM-3.3) by only spot-checking limited sections ('See also', 'Legacy', and top-of-page viewports) and not cross-checking the full outbound link set on the July 3, 2023 version of the pages. They ignored the presence of the genre link 'High fantasy' on The Lord of the Rings page, which leads directly to a page with an 'A Song of Ice and Fire' link, yielding a 2-click path. They also failed to actually load the specified July 3, 2023 revisions or to test alternative intermediaries. The verification criteria were defective and inherently biased to confirm the traversed 3-click route, resulting in a false confirmation of the minimum.
